# Flappy FMS

> Flappy FMS is a free online arcade flight game designed for the Faculty of Management Studies (FMS) community and web gamers. Players pilot a red eagle through neon-lit obstacles. No download or sign-up required — play instantly in any web browser or install as a Progressive Web App (PWA).

## About

Flappy FMS is built with pure HTML5 Canvas, Vanilla JavaScript, CSS3 and the Web Audio API. It features three game modes, six collectible power-ups, an FMS Campus Top 10 Leaderboard with pilot name entry, combo multipliers, medals, 28 achievements, parallax sky backgrounds, and per-mode high scores. The simulation runs on a fixed 60 Hz timestep so physics behave consistently across 60 Hz, 120 Hz and 144 Hz displays.

## Game Modes

- **Classic**: Balanced arcade flight with gradually increasing obstacle speed and tightening gaps.
- **Hardcore**: High-speed mode with vertically oscillating pillars and tight clearance.
- **Zen**: Relaxed, peaceful flight with wide gaps, gentle gravity and no speed ramp.

## FMS Campus Leaderboard

- Live Top 10 Hall of Fame ranking pilots across Classic, Hardcore, Zen, and combined scores.
- Players earning a Top 10 score can submit their custom Pilot Call Sign or Name.
- Instant score comparison and local persistent storage.

## Six Power-Ups

- **Golden Feather**: Instantly awards +5 bonus points (+10 with 2× active).
- **Shield Orb**: Absorbs one pillar collision, protecting the run.
- **Slow-Mo Clock**: Reduces obstacle speed by 45% and gravity by 25% for 6 seconds.
- **Magnet**: Pulls nearby collectibles toward the player for 8 seconds.
- **2× Points**: Doubles all points scored for 10 seconds, stacking with combo multipliers.
- **Ghost Phase**: Phase straight through pillars without crashing for 5 seconds.

## Scoring & Achievements

- Each pillar cleared scores 1 point multiplied by the current combo multiplier (up to ×5).
- Close calls (<20px clearance) award a bonus multiplier score.
- Medals awarded per run: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum.
- 28 unlockable achievements listed in the in-game Awards panel.

## Controls

- **Desktop**: Spacebar, Up Arrow or W to flap. Escape or P to pause. M to mute.
- **Mobile / Tablet**: Tap screen to flap. Full touch-screen support.

## PWA & Technical Stack

- Architecture: Progressive Web App with Service Worker offline caching (`sw.js`) and manifest (`manifest.webmanifest`).
- Rendering: HTML5 Canvas API (60 FPS fixed-timestep physics).
- Audio: Procedural Web Audio API sound synthesis.
- Storage: Safe localStorage wrapper (`Store`) with in-memory fallback.
